#Introduction 

This document contains code for cleaning and cross-referencing data entered in the data collection app Epicollect5 as part of Activity 1 of PSF's Salmon-Herring interactions project. The Epicolllect5 form *PSF Marine Science Fish Sampling* contains (1) Activity 1 field data and (2) non-salmonid stable isotope and otolith processing data. Epicollect5 creates several data sheets per form that can be cross-referenced with each other using auto-generated ID columns.

#Wrangle set data

```{r}
day <- day %>%
  #remove columns that are not of interest
  dplyr::select(-c(created_at, uploaded_at, created_by, 
                   title, day_start_time)) %>% 
  #rename unique ID reference columns
  rename(ec5_uuid_day = ec5_uuid) %>%
  #fix date format
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y"),
         year = lubridate::year(date),
         month = lubridate::month(date)) %>%
  relocate(c(year, month), .before = date) 

set <- set %>%
  #remove columns that are not of interest
  dplyr::select(-c(uploaded_at, created_by, title)) %>%
  #rename unique ID reference columns
  rename(ec5_uuid_set = ec5_uuid, 
         ec5_uuid_day = ec5_parent_uuid)
```


```{r}
##split set form into multiple forms by sampling type so that column can re-named and merged 
##(e.g., combine MT_Site_Location and BS_Site_Location into a single column)

#filter set "base" with ID columns and fishing event type
set_base <- set %>% 
  filter(event_type %in% c("Microtroll", "Beach Seine", "Purse Seine")) %>% #choose rows
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_day, ec5_uuid_set, created_at, event_type) %>% #choose columns
  rename(set_created_at = created_at) #rename column

#filter set "microtroll" with all microtrolling columns and rows
set_mt <- set %>% 
  filter(event_type == "Microtroll") %>% 
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_set, event_type, contains("MT_")) 

#filter set "beach seine" with all beach seine columns and rows
set_bs <- set %>%
  filter(event_type == "Beach Seine") %>% 
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_set, event_type, contains("BS_")) 

#filter set "purse seine" with all purse seine columns and rows
set_ps <- set  %>%
  filter(event_type == "Purse Seine") %>%
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_set, event_type, contains("PS_")) 

#check that the number of rows in the "base" is equal to the other three sets
nrow(set_base) - (nrow(set_mt) + nrow(set_bs) + nrow(set_ps))

#check the number of rows against the original set data
nrow(filter(set, event_type %in% c("Beach Seine", "Purse Seine", "Microtroll"))) - nrow(set_mt) - nrow(set_bs) - nrow(set_ps)

#remove prefix from column names
colnames(set_mt) <- gsub("MT_", "", colnames(set_mt))
colnames(set_bs) <- gsub("BS_", "", colnames(set_bs))
colnames(set_ps) <- gsub("PS_", "", colnames(set_ps))

#merge forms back together
set_clean <- set_mt %>%
  full_join(set_bs) %>%
  full_join(set_ps) %>%
  full_join(set_base)

#check that clean set matches base set
nrow(set_base) - nrow(set_clean)

#look at column names
colnames(set_clean)

#remove columns not of interest
set_clean <- set_clean %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(
    accuracy_set_start_gps, accuracy_set_end_gps, 
    UTM_Northing_set_start_gps, UTM_Easting_set_start_gps, UTM_Zone_set_start_gps,
    UTM_Northing_set_end_gps, UTM_Easting_set_end_gps, UTM_Zone_set_end_gps))

set_clean <- set_clean %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Herring = sum(Herring_Unkn_Size, Herring_SM_90mm, Herring_L_90mm, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  relocate(Herring, .before = Herring_Unkn_Size)

set_clean <- set_clean %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Herring_Unkn_Size, Herring_SM_90mm, Herring_L_90mm))

#replace 0s with NA for the species bycatch counts
set_clean <- set_clean %>%
  mutate(across(
    c("Salmonids", "Coho", "Chinook", "Chum", "Pink", "Sockeye", "Cutthroat_Trout", 
      "DV_Trout", "Steelhead_Trout","Herring", 
      "Northern_Anchovy", "Pacific_SandLance", "Smelt", "Bay_Pipefish", "Flatfishes", "Cods", 
      "Eelpouts", "Gobies", "Gunnels", "Greenlings", "Lampreys", "Lumpsuckers", 
      "Pacific_Sandfish", "Pacific_Spiny_Dog", "Plainfin_Midship", "Poachers", "Rockfishes", 
      "Ronquils", "Sculpins", "Snailfishes", "Surfperches", "Squids", "ThreeSpine_Stick", 
      "Tubesnout", "UNID_1", "UNID_2"), ~ ifelse(. == 0, NA, .)))

#reorder columns
set_clean <- set_clean %>% 
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_day, ec5_uuid_set, set_created_at, 
                event_type, set_location, set_start_time, set_end_time,
         lat_set_start_gps, long_set_start_gps,
         lat_set_end_gps, long_set_end_gps, 
         surface_temp_c, salinity_ppt, sea_state, number_vessels, tow_duration_min,
         everything())

colnames(set_clean)
```


```{r}
#merge day and set forms
day_set <- right_join(day, set_clean, by = "ec5_uuid_day")
colnames(day_set)

#reorder columns
day_set <- day_set %>%
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_day, ec5_uuid_set, project, year, month, date, general_location, 
                team, vessels, crew, pit_scanner, everything()) %>%
  dplyr::select(-set_comments, set_comments, -qc_set, qc_set) 

day_set <- unite(day_set, set_comments, set_comments, qc_set, na.rm = TRUE, sep = "; ")
day_set <- unite(day_set, day_comments, day_comments, qc_check, na.rm = TRUE, sep = "; ")

day_set <- unite(day_set, set_start_gps, lat_set_start_gps, long_set_start_gps, 
                 na.rm = TRUE, remove = FALSE, sep = ", ")
day_set <- unite(day_set, set_end_gps, lat_set_end_gps, long_set_end_gps, 
                 na.rm = TRUE, remove = FALSE, sep = ", ")
```

#Wrangle fish biodata

```{r}

#remove prefix from column names
colnames(mt) <- gsub("^MT_", "", colnames(mt))
colnames(bs) <- gsub("^BS_", "", colnames(bs))
colnames(ps) <- gsub("^PS_", "", colnames(ps))

#general wrangling
mt <- mt %>% dplyr::select(-c(uploaded_at, created_by, title)) %>% #remove columns
  mutate(pit_tray = as.factor(pit_tray)) %>% #convert pit_tray to factor
  mutate(fin_vial = as.factor(fin_vial))

bs <- bs %>% dplyr::select(-c(uploaded_at, created_by, title)) %>%
  mutate(pit_tray = as.factor(pit_tray)) %>%
  mutate(fin_vial = as.factor(fin_vial))

ps <- ps %>% dplyr::select(-c(uploaded_at, created_by, title)) %>%
  mutate(pit_tray = as.factor(pit_tray)) %>%
  mutate(fin_vial = as.factor(fin_vial))

#combine data frames
combined_df <- mt %>% full_join(bs) %>% full_join(ps)

#rename unique ID reference columns
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  rename(ec5_uuid_set = ec5_branch_owner_uuid) %>%
  rename(fish_created_at = created_at)

colnames(combined_df)
```

#Merge set data with fish biodata

```{r}

#summarize number of fish in biodata branches per set
biodata.count <- combined_df %>%
  #remove rows without fish
  filter(!is.na(ec5_branch_uuid)) %>%
  #select columns of interest
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_set, species) %>%
  #group by set and species
  group_by(ec5_uuid_set, species) %>%
  #summarize number of species per set
  summarise(number = n())

#list of unique species in branches
unique(biodata.count$species)

#pivot wider
biodata.count <- biodata.count %>%
  mutate(species = paste0(species, "_Branch")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = species, values_from = number) %>%
  rename(Herring_Branch = Herring_Unkn_Size_Branch)

#merge with set data to get full counts of catches for each set
day_set <- full_join(day_set, biodata.count, by = "ec5_uuid_set")

#add together bycatch number and branch biodata number
day_set <- day_set %>%
  group_by(ec5_uuid_set) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Rockfishes2 = sum(Rockfishes, Rockfishes_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Coho2 = sum(Coho, Coho_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Chinook2 = sum(Chinook, Chinook_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Herring2 = sum(Herring, Herring_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Pink2 = sum(Pink, Pink_Branch, na.rm  = TRUE),
         Cutthroat_Trout2 = sum(Cutthroat_Trout, Cutthroat_Trout_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Greenlings2 = sum(Greenlings, Greenlings_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Flatfishes2 = sum(Flatfishes, Flatfishes_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Sockeye2 = sum(Sockeye, Sockeye_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Chum2 = sum(Chum, Chum_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Pacific_Spiny_Dog2 = sum(Pacific_Spiny_Dog, Pacific_Spiny_Dog_Branch, na.rm = TRUE),
         Unidentified = sum(UNID_1, UNID_2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()


#relocate columns
day_set <- day_set %>%
  relocate(Rockfishes2, .before = Rockfishes) %>%
  relocate(Coho2, .before = Coho) %>%
  relocate(Chinook2, .before = Chinook) %>%
  relocate(Herring2, .before = Herring) %>%
  relocate(Pink2, .before = Pink) %>%
  relocate(Cutthroat_Trout2, .before = Cutthroat_Trout) %>%
  relocate(Greenlings2, .before = Greenlings) %>%
  relocate(Flatfishes2, .before = Flatfishes) %>%
  relocate(Sockeye2, .before = Sockeye) %>%
  relocate(Chum2, .before = Chum) %>%
  relocate(Pacific_Spiny_Dog2, .before = Pacific_Spiny_Dog) %>%
  relocate(Unidentified, .before = UNID_1)

#check that column sums worked by looking at an example
test <- day_set %>%
  dplyr::select(Chinook2, Chinook, Chinook_Branch)
#looks good

#remove extra columns
day_set <- day_set %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Rockfishes, Rockfishes_Branch, Coho, Coho_Branch,
                   Chinook, Chinook_Branch, Herring, Herring_Branch,
                   Pink, Pink_Branch, Cutthroat_Trout, Cutthroat_Trout_Branch,
                   Greenlings, Greenlings_Branch, Flatfishes, Flatfishes_Branch,
                   Sockeye, Sockeye_Branch, Chum, Chum_Branch, Pacific_Spiny_Dog, 
                   Pacific_Spiny_Dog_Branch, UNID_1, UNID_1_Feat, UNID_1_Phot,
                   UNID_2, UNID_2_Feat, UNID_2_Phot))

#rename existing columns
day_set <- day_set %>%
  rename(Rockfishes = Rockfishes2,
         Coho = Coho2,
         Chinook = Chinook2,
         Herring = Herring2,
         Pink = Pink2,
         Cutthroat_Trout = Cutthroat_Trout2,
         Greenlings = Greenlings2,
         Flatfishes = Flatfishes2,
         Sockeye = Sockeye2,
         Chum = Chum2,
         Pacific_Spiny_Dog = Pacific_Spiny_Dog2)

#replace 0s with NA for the species counts
day_set <- day_set %>%
  mutate(across(
    c("Salmonids", "Coho", "Chinook", "Chum", "Pink", "Sockeye", "Cutthroat_Trout", 
      "DV_Trout", "Steelhead_Trout","Herring", 
      "Northern_Anchovy", "Pacific_SandLance", "Smelt", "Bay_Pipefish", "Flatfishes", "Cods", 
      "Eelpouts", "Gobies", "Gunnels", "Greenlings", "Lampreys", "Lumpsuckers", 
      "Pacific_Sandfish", "Pacific_Spiny_Dog", "Plainfin_Midship", "Poachers", "Rockfishes", 
      "Ronquils", "Sculpins", "Snailfishes", "Surfperches", "Squids", "ThreeSpine_Stick", 
      "Tubesnout", "Unidentified"), ~ ifelse(. == 0, NA, .)))

#combine fish_biodata with day_set data
combined_df <- full_join(day_set, combined_df)

#reorder columns
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  relocate(c(ec5_branch_uuid, fish_photo, set_created_at, fish_created_at), 
           .after = ec5_uuid_set) %>%
  relocate(c(species, clip_status, fork_length_mm, fish_depth_ft, lure_color,
             scale_book, scale_no, gastric_lavage, lavage_bag,
             tag_status, pit_scanner, pit_tray, tag_id_short, biopsy_vial,
             fin_vial, pre_injury, handling_injury, sign_symp, 
             whatman_sheet, whatman_no, fish_weight_g, fish_comments, qc_fish), 
           .after = biosample_count)

combined_df <- 
  unite(combined_df, fish_comments, fish_comments, qc_fish, na.rm = TRUE, sep = "; ")

```

#Fill in variables that are recorded only when values change

Certain variables such as sea state, number of hooks fished, and set location, are only recorded within a day when these variables change. We need to fill in the rest of the rows.

```{r}
#sort data and fill other variables (recorded only when values change)
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(fish_created_at) %>%
  arrange(set_created_at) %>%
  arrange(date, general_location, team) %>%
  group_by(ec5_uuid_day) %>% #group by day
  tidyr::fill(c("sea_state", "number_vessels", "set_time_min",
                "sides_fished", "deepest_hook_ft", "interval_hook_ft", "number_hooks",
                "surface_rod", "set_location", "pit_tray", "whatman_sheet"), 
              .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup()

#removed filled PIT tray if no tag applied
combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  mutate(pit_tray = case_when(is.na(tag_id_short)  ~ NA, TRUE ~ pit_tray))

#remove filled PIT tray for recaps or tagging status missing (could be sneaky recaps)
combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  mutate(pit_tray = case_when(
    tag_status == "recap" ~ NA, 
    is.na(tag_status) ~ NA,
    TRUE ~ pit_tray))

#remove filled Whatman Sheet if no Whatman Square
combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  mutate(whatman_sheet = case_when(is.na(whatman_no)  ~ NA, TRUE ~ whatman_sheet))


```

#QC & Cleaning: PIT tag data

```{r}

#PIT Tray QC

#view unique PIT tray entries
unique(combined_df$pit_tray)

#write a list of PIT trays recorded as "Other" for manual QC
test <- filter(combined_df, pit_tray == "Other (specify in comments)")
#PIT tray recorded as 529 in the comments, but this is not a PIT tray number
#remove this PIT tray - we don't really need it 
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(pit_tray = case_when(
    ec5_uuid_day == "59c13c97-dc73-49d4-b5c6-017384f52189" & 
      pit_tray == "Other (specify in comments)" ~ NA,
    TRUE ~ pit_tray))

#check it worked
unique(combined_df$pit_tray)

#fill in leading "APT" for PIT trays recorded as just numbers
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(pit_tray = if_else(grepl("^\\d{6}$", pit_tray), 
                            paste0("APT", pit_tray), pit_tray))

#check that the replacement worked
unique(combined_df$pit_tray)


#Other tagging QC: look through different possible error scenarios
unique(combined_df$tag_status)

#tagging status is missing, but tag was recorded
test <- combined_df %>% 
  filter(is.na(tag_status) & !is.na(tag_id_short)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, tag_status, tag_id_short)
nrow(test)
#no instances

#tagging status is "no tag will be applied", but tag was recorded
test <- combined_df %>% 
  filter(tag_status == "no_tag" & !is.na(tag_id_short)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, tag_status, tag_id_short)
nrow(test)
#no instances

#tagging status is "tag will be applied", but NO tag was recorded  
test <- combined_df %>% 
  filter(tag_status == "tag" & is.na(tag_id_short)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, species, 
         fork_length_mm, tag_status, tag_id_short, fish_comments)
nrow(test)
#three instances 
#one instance - tag was applied but not scanned
#two instances - unclear whether tag was applied but not scanned or never applied

#tagging status is "recap", but NO tag was recorded 
test <- combined_df %>% 
  filter(tag_status == "recap" & is.na(tag_id_short)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pit_scanner, date, general_location, 
         set_start_time, tag_status, tag_id_short, fish_comments)
nrow(test)
#no instances

#PIT scanner missing, but tags detected/applied
test <- combined_df %>%
  group_by(ec5_uuid_day) %>%
  filter(is.na(pit_scanner) & !is.na(tag_id_short)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pit_scanner, date, general_location, 
         set_start_time, tag_status, tag_id_short, fish_comments)
nrow(test)
#no instances

#PIT tray missing, but tags recorded (excluding recaps) 
test <- combined_df %>%  
  filter(is.na(pit_tray) & !is.na(tag_id_short) & tag_status != "recap") %>%
  dplyr::select(date, crew, general_location, set_start_time, tag_id_short, day_comments, fish_comments)
nrow(test)
#there are several instances of this that I don't think can be fixed
#but I also don't think it matters - ignore

```

#QC & Cleaning: Scale data

The scale book number was recorded once per day on the first time that scale book was used. Scale books are species-specific: there is one for Chinook and (sometimes) one for Coho. We only took scales from Coho early in the year, then dropped that part of the protocol. We need to fill in the rest of the rows.

```{r}

#because a couple species IDs were changed after looking at the field photos,
#the scale book needs to be added for those fish (because the scale book fill
#is species-specific). This was previously done in Epicollect, but it's no longer
#easy to download the Epicollect data using R, so making a couple changes here 
#instead
combined_df <- combined_df %>% mutate(scale_book = case_when(
  ec5_branch_uuid == "e379dfba-9165-4d1a-ad58-6cd02c0182cd" ~ 90,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "2d58a325-7ab9-4615-8408-75a3de960518" ~ 84,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "41538bb1-abf0-4bf6-b39c-ff221c621d27" ~ 284,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "24df4b48-911c-4ef7-9946-61a5ca2bf4e4" ~ 22397,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "2e6760a4-9fab-40c1-95ea-68aa82aa2cd4" ~ 265,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "8f8beb3c-2b30-426d-b96a-ca544aadc7cf" ~ 22397,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "7e5f705b-9964-4012-bc7c-769b04e821e9" ~ 130,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "526a522e-8227-4c5a-88fb-f663dc6410d3" ~ 265,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "37c13b44-cc02-4eec-9a08-966b89024d6c" ~ 283,
  ec5_branch_uuid == "4a360594-c70d-4dfd-9974-50b8ed95c588" ~ 265,
  TRUE ~ scale_book))

#sort data and fill scale book number (species-specific)
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  arrange(fish_created_at) %>% 
  arrange(set_created_at) %>% 
  arrange(species) %>% 
  arrange(date, general_location) %>%
  #group by day and species
  group_by(ec5_uuid_day, species) %>% 
  #fill scale book to subsequent fish within a day
  tidyr::fill("scale_book", .direction = "down") %>%
  #remove scale book if no scales were taken
  mutate(scale_book = case_when(is.na(scale_no) ~ NA, TRUE ~ scale_book)) %>%
  #convert PSF scale books to PSFXXXX form
  mutate(scale_book = case_when(nchar(scale_book) <= 3 ~ paste0("PSF", str_pad(as.factor(scale_book), width = 4, pad = "0")), TRUE ~ as.factor(scale_book))) %>%
  ungroup()

combined_df <- combined_df %>% mutate(scale_book = case_when(
  is.na(scale_book) & !is.na(scale_no) & 
    ec5_uuid_day == "305fb8ff-a2d5-4ce7-8046-fa9748d3b087" ~ "PSF0157", 
  TRUE ~ scale_book))


#check that it worked
sort(unique(combined_df$scale_book))
```

#QC & Cleaning: Temperature and salinity data

During beach and purse seining, the surface water temperature was recorded once for each site per day on the first (usually but not always) fishing set at that site. During microtrolling, the surface water temperature was recorded once per day. We need to merge these data into a single column

*FLAG* how should we deal with beach/purse seine days where a temp is recorded in day? - ignore because we don't know what site it refers to

```{r}

#combine surface_temp for microtrolling (recorded in the day form) 
#with beach and purse seining (recorded in the set form)
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(surface_temp_c = case_when(event_type == "Microtroll" ~ day_surface_temp_c,
                                    TRUE ~ surface_temp_c)) 

#check that it worked
test <- combined_df %>% dplyr::select(date, event_type, day_surface_temp_c, surface_temp_c)

#remove extra temperature column
combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  dplyr::select(-day_surface_temp_c)

```

Similar to temperature, salinity was recorded once for each site per day on the first (usually but not always) fishing set at that site during beach and purse seining. Salinity was not recorded during microtrolling. We need to copy the temperature and salinity data into the other subsequent sets at the same site on the same day. 

Note: we do not want to group together sites listed as "Other" because these may not actually be from the same location. Solution: Add dummy temp/salinity variables to "Other" location sets that do not have their own temp/salinity values to prevent filling, then replace dummy variable with NA. 

```{r}

## Temperature and Salinity ##

combined_df <- combined_df %>% 
  #sort data in chronological order & group by day and set location
  arrange(fish_created_at) %>%
  arrange(set_created_at) %>%
  arrange(date, general_location) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(ec5_uuid_day, set_location) %>% #group by day and site 
  #add dummy variables for "Other" location sets
  mutate(
    #if site name "Other" and temp not recorded, set surface temp to dummy variable "12345"
    surface_temp_c2 = 
      case_when(set_location == "Other (specify in comments)" & is.na(surface_temp_c) ~ 12345, 
                TRUE ~ surface_temp_c),
    #same for salinity
    salinity_ppt2 = 
      case_when(set_location == "Other (specify in comments)" & is.na(salinity_ppt) ~ 12345,
                TRUE ~ salinity_ppt)) %>%
  #do the fill, direction "downup" fills downward first and then upward
  tidyr::fill(c("surface_temp_c2", "salinity_ppt2"), .direction = "downup") %>% 
  ungroup() %>%
  #replace dummy "12345" values with NA
  mutate(surface_temp_c2 = na_if(surface_temp_c2, 12345),
         salinity_ppt2 = na_if(salinity_ppt2, 12345)) %>%
  relocate(c("surface_temp_c2", "salinity_ppt2"), .after = surface_temp_c)


#check whether fill was done correctly
test <-
  combined_df %>% distinct(ec5_uuid_set, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, set_location, salinity_ppt, salinity_ppt2, surface_temp_c, surface_temp_c2)

#remove duplicate columns
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(surface_temp_c, salinity_ppt)) %>%
  rename(surface_temp_c = surface_temp_c2,
         salinity_ppt = salinity_ppt2)

#check that recorded salinities & temperatures are reasonable
summary(combined_df$surface_temp_c)
summary(combined_df$salinity_ppt) #this range is somewhat larger than I might expect

```

```{r}
#look at unique fin clip vials
```

#Lethal samples

Lethal samples include fish euthanized for lab sampling and accidental mortalities. Most lethal samples are recorded in the lethal sample section of the form, but for microtrolling (or for fish with biosamples taken), they are recorded in the biosample branch with PIT tagging status "Euthanized and Retained" or "mort"


```{r}
#rename data sheet reference columns
mort_clean <- mort %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(created_at, uploaded_at, created_by, title, LS_photo)) %>%
  rename(ec5_uuid_mort = ec5_branch_uuid,
         ec5_uuid_set = ec5_branch_owner_uuid) 

colnames(mort_clean) <- gsub("LS_", "", colnames(mort_clean))

mort_biosample <- combined_df %>%
  filter(tag_status %in% c("euth", "mort")) %>%
  dplyr::select(ec5_uuid_set, ec5_branch_uuid, species) %>%
  mutate(number = 1)

mort_data <- full_join(mort_clean, mort_biosample)

mort_data <- mort_data %>%
  relocate(ec5_branch_uuid, .after = ec5_uuid_mort)
```

#Combine lethal samples and other (lethal) samples

```{r}
#add other samples to the combined df and filter down to 1 row per set
combined_df_other <- full_join(combined_df %>%
                                  group_by(ec5_uuid_set) %>%
                                  slice(1) %>%
                                  dplyr::select(
                                    ec5_uuid_day, ec5_uuid_set, project, date,
                                    general_location, team, event_type, set_location, 
                                    surface_temp_c, set_start_time, set_end_time, 
                                    lat_set_start_gps, long_set_start_gps,
                                    lat_set_end_gps, long_set_end_gps, 
                                    set_comments),
                                  other_df %>%
                                  dplyr::select(-c(crew)))

#merge set and mort data
mort_data <- inner_join(combined_df_other, mort_data)


# test <- mort_data %>%
#   filter(species == "Chinook",
#          event_type == "Microtroll") %>%
#   dplyr::select(event_type, date, general_location, set_start_time, 
#                 species, ec5_uuid_set, ec5_uuid_mort, ec5_branch_uuid, Comments)

#take the average lat/long (this will only affect microtrolling)
mort_data$lat_Mean_GPS <- rowMeans(mort_data[, c("lat_set_start_gps", "lat_set_end_gps")], na.rm = TRUE)
mort_data$long_Mean_GPS <- rowMeans(mort_data[, c("long_set_start_gps", "long_set_end_gps")], na.rm = TRUE)


mort_data_print <- mort_data %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(lat_set_start_gps, long_set_start_gps,
            lat_set_end_gps, long_set_end_gps, set_comments,
            set_start_time, set_end_time, ec5_uuid_day, ec5_uuid_set, ec5_uuid_mort, ec5_branch_uuid,
            life_stage, size_herring)) %>%
  relocate(c(lat_Mean_GPS, long_Mean_GPS), .after = set_location) %>%
  relocate(general_location, .before = set_location) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  arrange(general_location) %>%
  arrange(species) 

write.csv(mort_data_print, file = paste0(Sys.Date(), "-psf-herring-A1-field-lethal-samples", ".csv"))

```

#Integrate mort data into main catch data

```{r}

mort_data_wide <- mort_data %>%
  group_by(ec5_uuid_set, species) %>%
  summarise(number = sum(number, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(species = case_when(species == "Herring_Unkn_Size" ~ "Herring",
                                   TRUE ~ species)) %>%
  mutate(species = paste0(species, "_Lethal")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = species, values_from = number) 

# mort_data_wide[is.na(mort_data_wide)] <- 0

combined_df <- left_join(combined_df, mort_data_wide)

combined_df <- combined_df %>% relocate(set_comments, .after = last_col())
```

#Isotope data

Isotope samples are collected from fish in the lab. This form contains all non-Coho or Chinook stable isotope entries. Coho and Chinook isotope samples are found in the gastric lavage form.

```{r}

isotope_clean <- isotope %>%
  rename(ec5_uuid_set = ec5_branch_owner_uuid) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(uploaded_at, created_by, title))

colnames(isotope_clean) <- gsub("SI_", "", colnames(isotope_clean))

isotope_clean <- isotope_clean %>%
  mutate(Length_Type = case_when(species %in% c("Chinook", "Coho", "Pink", "Chum", "Sockeye") ~ "Fork",
                                 TRUE ~ "Standard")) %>%
  relocate(Length_Type, .after = length_mm)


isotope_combined <- right_join(combined_df_other, isotope_clean)

#take the average lat/long (this will only affect microtrolling)
isotope_combined$lat_Mean_GPS <- rowMeans(isotope_combined[, c("lat_set_start_gps", "lat_set_end_gps")], na.rm = TRUE)
isotope_combined$long_Mean_GPS <- rowMeans(isotope_combined[, c("long_set_start_gps", "long_set_end_gps")], na.rm = TRUE)


#check for fish with no code entered
test <- isotope_combined %>%
  filter(is.na(sample_code)) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, sample_code)
nrow(test)


#fix funky sample codes 
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>% arrange(sample_code)
unique(isotope_combined$sample_code)


#resolve typos and formatting problems
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>%
  mutate(sample_code_Num = as.numeric(str_extract(sample_code, "\\d+")),
         sample_code_Num2 = sprintf("%03d", sample_code_Num),
         sample_code_Base = "BCSRIF_",
         sample_code = paste0(sample_code_Base, sample_code_Num2)) %>%
  arrange(sample_code)

#check that it worked
unique(isotope_combined$sample_code)

#check for duplicated codes
dup <- isotope_combined$sample_code[duplicated(isotope_combined$sample_code)]
sort(dup)

test <- isotope_combined %>%
  filter(sample_code_Num %in% dup) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, sample_code)
nrow(test)

#check for gaps in the codes
expected <- seq(min(isotope_combined$sample_code_Num, na.rm = TRUE),
                max(isotope_combined$sample_code_Num, na.rm = TRUE))
missing_vals <- setdiff(expected, isotope_combined$sample_code_Num)
missing_vals

#check for rows with no species recorded
test <- isotope_combined %>% filter(is.na(species))
nrow(test)

#check for rows with species recorded as "other"
test <- isotope_combined %>%
  filter(species == "Other (Specify in Comments)") %>%
  dplyr::select(date, general_location, set_start_time, species, sample_code, comments)
nrow(test)

#weight to length regression
colnames(isotope_combined)
# library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = isotope_combined) +
  geom_point(aes(x = length_mm, y = weight_g, color = species)) +
  facet_wrap(~species) +
  theme_bw()
#displays at bottom of chunk


#manually fix an error in the sample type column (from the first couple fish)
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>%
  mutate(sample_type = case_when(
    as.numeric(sample_code_Num) <= 77 & is.na(sample_type) ~ "Muscle Plug",
    TRUE ~ sample_type))

#manually fix an error with the ruler used in the second year of processing
#Ryan + Tristan used fork board that had a ruler offset to the right by 1mm
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>% mutate(
  length_mm2 = case_when(
    year(date) == 2025 & as.Date(created_at) < as.Date("2026-01-01") & as.Date(created_at) > as.Date("2025-11-01")~ length_mm - 1,
    TRUE ~ length_mm)) %>%
  relocate(length_mm2, .after = length_mm)
#looks good

isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>% 
  dplyr::select(-length_mm) %>%
  rename(length_mm = length_mm2)

#remove length for BCSRIF_332 (length suspiciously small for time of year
#and otolith suspiciously large)
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>% 
  mutate(length_mm = case_when(sample_code == "BCSRIF_332" ~ NA,
                               TRUE ~ length_mm))

#add a note about some pink and chum give to Jamie
isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>%
  mutate(comments = case_when(sample_code %in% c(
    'BCSRIF_844', 'BCSRIF_845', 'BCSRIF_846', 'BCSRIF_847', 'BCSRIF_848', 'BCSRIF_849',
    'BCSRIF_850', 'BCSRIF_851', 'BCSRIF_852', 'BCSRIF_853', 'BCSRIF_854', 'BCSRIF_855',
    'BCSRIF_856', 'BCSRIF_858', 'BCSRIF_863', 'BCSRIF_870', 'BCSRIF_871', 'BCSRIF_873',
    'BCSRIF_874', 'BCSRIF_877', 'BCSRIF_878', 'BCSRIF_880') ~ paste0(
      comments, "; ", "whole body samples given to Jaime Grimm"),
    TRUE ~ comments))

isotope_combined <- isotope_combined %>%
  mutate(year = year(date),
         month = month(date)) %>%
  relocate(year, .after = date) %>%
  relocate(month, .after = year) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(sample_code) %>%
  relocate(c(lat_Mean_GPS, long_Mean_GPS), .after = set_start_time) %>%
  relocate(general_location, .before = set_location) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(lat_set_start_gps, long_set_start_gps,  
                   lat_set_end_gps, long_set_end_gps, ec5_uuid_day, 
                   ec5_uuid_set, ec5_branch_uuid, set_comments, set_end_time,
                   sample_code_Base, sample_code_Num, sample_code_Num2, qc_check,
                   accuracy_set_start_gps))

write.csv(isotope_combined, file = paste0(Sys.Date(), "-psf-herring-A1-field-isotope-net-sampled", ".csv"))

```
#QC - check that all morts are processed 

```{r}
summary1 <- mort_data %>% 
  group_by(date, general_location, set_location, event_type, 
           species) %>% 
  summarise(caught = sum(number, na.rm = TRUE))

summary2 <- isotope_combined %>%
  group_by(date, general_location, set_location, event_type,
           species) %>%
  summarise(processed = n())

summary <- full_join(summary1, summary2) %>%
  filter(!species %in% c("Chinook", "Coho")) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(comments = "")

test <- summary %>% filter(species == "Herring_Unkn_Size")

write.csv(summary, paste0(Sys.Date(), "-field-isotope-data-differences.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

```
